product_one_liner.value: D·engage is a customer-experience data platform that unifies customer data and enables marketers to run personalized, omnichannel engagement across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, web and on-site messaging.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Core, Pro and Enterprise packages, with tailored rather than fixed prices.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 156 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is primarily marketing, product and business content; it does not establish two engineer-authored engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The developer documentation site contains multiple linked product and API articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The accessible careers evidence shows open business-development and software-engineering roles, but no AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM or computer-vision title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public documentation, trust material and blog identify Zeki AI but do not identify an underlying model or external model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The page specifically names SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR; ISO 27701 and CSA/KVKK were not included because the requested list is restricted to five categories.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent listed round is a September 2025 Series A, inside the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The cited live postings are for Business Development Representatives.

launched_6mo.notes: D·engage publicly announced Smart Search Overlays on 2026-10-21.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The cited profile records Mirza Mansoor Baig as VP of Customer Experience at Dengage from December 2025.
